name: Fentanyl
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Benzodiazepines and other CNS depressants (gabapentin, pregabalin, other opioids, alcohol)
key_interactions.effect: Profound sedation, respiratory depression, coma and death (label boxed warning).
key_interactions.action: Reserve for patients without alternatives; limit dose and duration; monitor closely.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: CYP3A4 inhibitors (erythromycin, clarithromycin, ketoconazole, itraconazole, fluconazole, ritonavir); grapefruit juice
key_interactions.effect: Higher fentanyl levels; prolonged effects and fatal respiratory depression (label boxed warning).
key_interactions.action: Consider a lower fentanyl dose; monitor for respiratory depression; watch for withdrawal when the inhibitor stops.

key_interactions.effect: Lower fentanyl levels and withdrawal; toxicity when the inducer stops (label).

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Serotonergic drugs (SSRIs, SNRIs, tricyclics, triptans, tramadol)
key_interactions.action: Observe closely; stop if serotonin syndrome is suspected.
